steps.hardClue: Press the skull button, then match the pairs of symbols on the floor.
steps.clue: Press the skull button, then match all twelve pairs of floor symbols.

steps.hardClue: Have three players stand on the grate while the fourth activates a hidden switch.
steps.clue: Have three players stand on the grate while the fourth activates the hidden switch on the water slide.

steps.hardClue: Free the crystal, shrink it with the Wonder Weapon, then launch it into the air.
steps.clue: Free the crystal above the slide, shrink it with the 31-79 JGb215, then launch it from the geyser.

steps.hardClue: Turn the valve and lead the special zombie past all four gas leaks.
steps.clue: Turn the valve and lead a Napalm Zombie past all four gas leaks.

steps.hardClue: Plug the tunnel holes with explosive mines, then press the hidden brick.
steps.clue: Plug the tunnel holes with explosive mines, then press the waterfall brick.

steps.hardClue: Knife all twelve wall panels, then destroy the wooden structure.
steps.clue: Knife all twelve wall panels, then destroy the tent near the minecart.

steps.hardClue: Rotate the four stone dials to the correct symbols.
steps.clue: Rotate the four mud-room dials to the correct symbols.

steps.hardClue: Knife the gongs, shoot the crystal, then catch the falling explosives.
steps.clue: Knife the four correct gongs, shoot the crystal, then catch the falling dynamite.

steps.hardClue: Shrink the meteorite, use the dynamite behind the temple wall, then collect the artifact.
steps.clue: Shrink the meteorite, use the dynamite behind Pack-a-Punch, then collect the Focusing Stone.
